item.title: Bulletin updated at 18:50 HKT 03/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over southern China in the next couple of days. It will be slightly cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China during the weekend and early next week. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong on Monday. It will be dry during the day over the region in the following couple of days. An easterly airstream is expected to affect southeastern China in the latter part of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Krathon will move across Taiwan today and tomorrow and weaken significantly.
